# Pie Raises $19.5M in Series A Funding

 By FinSMEs 

June 30, 2026

Syed Ali (left), co-founder and CEO of Pie, and Akhil Mantripragada (right), co-founder and CTO of Pie

Pie, a NYC-based provider of an AI-powered growth platform for small businesses, raised $19.5m in Series A funding.

The round, which brought total funding to $23.7m, was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from Capital One Ventures, Max Levchin’s SciFi VC, F-Prime, Commerce Ventures, WEX Venture Capital, and existing investors. 

The company intends to use the funds to scale its platform distribution model, deepen its product suite and grow its team. 

Led by Syed Ali, CEO and Akhil Mantripragada, CTO, Pie provides an AI-powered growth platform for small businesses. Through Growth, AI Search and Front Desk, the company helps local merchants get discovered, bring in more customers and convert demand into revenue across the channels where customers are already looking.

Since launching its first AI-powered growth product in late 2025, Pie has grown to reach thousands of small business customers while in stealth, largely through referrals and platform partnerships.

The company also launched Front Desk, an AI product that answers calls for small business owners 24/7, takes bookings and reservations, and responds to customer questions.

 Investment will help accelerate Pie’s next phase of growth, supporting the expansion of its platform partnerships, product suite and team 

 Pie, the AI-powered growth platform for small businesses, today announced an investment from Amex Ventures, the corporate venture capital arm of American Express. The investment follows Pie’s emergence from stealth in June, and the announcement of its $19.5 million Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from Capital One Ventures, Max Levchin’s SciFi VC, F-Prime, Commerce Ventures, WEX Venture Capital and existing investors. 

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260804437204/en/

 

 As customer discovery continues to evolve across digital and AI-powered experiences, many small business owners don't have the time, budget, or expertise to manage their presence across an increasingly complex landscape. Many also rely on marketing solutions that make it difficult to understand which activities are driving meaningful business results. Pie was built to help businesses get discovered, capture demand, and connect customer engagement to measurable business outcomes. 

 Through three core offerings, AI Search helps businesses improve their visibility as local discovery shifts to AI-powered search experiences like ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity; Growth helps businesses acquire customers across high-intent local channels like Google Maps, Yelp and Nextdoor; and Front Desk uses a voice agent to answer calls, take bookings and respond to customer questions.

# Pie Receives Investment from Amex Ventures

 By FinSMEs 

August 4, 2026

Pie, a Boston, MA-based provider of an AI-powered growth platform for small businesses, received an investment from Amex Ventures.

The amount of the deal was not disclosed.

The raise brought the total amount in Series A to $19.5M.

The company intends to use the funds to accelerate its mission and reach more small businesses across the country.

Led by CEO Syed Ali and CTO Akhil Mantripragada, Pie provides a platform that helps local merchants get discovered, capture demand, and convert engagement into revenue. They offers three core solutions, including

- AI Search: to improve visibility across AI search experiences such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity; 
- Growth: to acquire customers across local channels like Google Maps, Yelp, and Nextdoor;
- and Front Desk: a voice agent that answers calls, takes bookings, and responds to customer inquiries. 

Pie currently operates across categories including auto repair, pet care, fitness, and beauty services, having driven over 100,000 phone calls to client businesses.
